cloud_json_reproduced.note: compute() re-executed with read-only pair-sum caches; every key except provenance compared exactly

checks.check: common step after survey monopoles has |z| < 2 (white + exact body)
single-survey all-sky samples (TF_ALL, SN_ALL) each keep a step with |z| >= 2 and agree in sign
constant quadrupole of log_survey has Wald p >= 0.01

checks.branch: H-L5a REJECTED as an excess over the body
checks.check: joint null of log_survey has p >= 0.01

checks.branch: robust class stays DEPENDS_ON_ZERO_POINT_NUISANCE_MODEL; the table is quoted; H-L5c stays HOLD
checks.check: class identical for pooled, log_mono, log_survey, log_mono_radial, log_mono_galactic, log_mono_error

decision.note: decision checks evaluated once with the contract thresholds; the R54-L05 decision block is not edited

label_join.rule: FP_SDSS / FP_NOT_SDSS / FP_MIXED by galaxy PGC in the SDSS FP catalogue; TF_ALL, SN_ALL, OTHER_ALL

leave_6dfgs_proxy_out.selection: log_mono window fit without FP_NOT_SDSS and FP_MIXED (6dFGSv is not separable from them)

limitations: Survey labels resolve only SDSS vs non-SDSS FP; 6dFGSv, TF samples or bands and SN compilations are not separable with owned files (DV-L04-1, DV-L04-2).
Same body assumptions as R54-L05 (linear theory, redshift-space positions, no selection or calibration covariance between objects).
SDSS FP is a northern sample and non-SDSS FP is mostly southern, so an FP survey offset and an FP hemisphere step are close to degenerate.
